name: Kleister NDA: Key Information Extraction from Long Complex Legal Documents
description: Kleister NDA is a challenging document key information extraction benchmark comprising 540 long, complex non-disclosure agreement (NDA) legal documents compiled from public SEC EDGAR regulatory filings by Applica.ai. Spanning a total of 1,770 pages (averaging 3.3 pages per document), Kleister NDA benchmarks extraction of critical contract entities—including involved parties, effective dates, agreement titles, and governing jurisdictions. In contrast to classic form understanding datasets that isolate short single-page layouts, Kleister NDA evaluates information extraction from multi-page documents containing extensive unconstrained text, legal prose, and diverse OCR rendering conditions.

license.name: Unspecified by Source / Public Regulatory Filings
license.notes: Evaluation scripts and benchmark manifests are provided on GitHub under the MIT License. Source NDA contracts were obtained from public corporate disclosure filings on US SEC EDGAR. While regulatory filings are publicly accessible public records, individual corporate contracts and agreements may contain proprietary third-party content. The dataset publishers did not grant a blanket commercial redistribution license for the compiled PDF and OCR document corpus, so dataset-wide commercial usability remains unverified.

source_references.title: Kleister: Key Information Extraction Datasets Involving Long Documents with Complex Layouts (ICDAR 2021)

verification.notes: Verified against applicaai/kleister-nda repository and ICDAR 2021 proceedings (DOI: 10.1007/978-3-030-86540-5_37). Confirmed 540 documents (254 train, 83 dev-0, 203 test-A), multi-page layout characteristics, dual OCR text pipeline, and SEC EDGAR public provenance. Distinguishes MIT evaluation code and open TSV manifests from underlying third-party contract PDFs and OCR text, with unverified dataset-wide commercial reuse rights.

size.notes: PDF document scans paired with pre-computed OCR outputs from pdf2djvu/djvu2hocr and Tesseract.

provenance.collection_method: Harvested from public non-disclosure agreements submitted to the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) EDGAR disclosure system, converted from HTML/text to PDF via Puppeteer.
provenance.curation_notes: Measures full-document key information extraction performance rather than entity token classification. Documents are recorded separately from OCR word tokens. Distinguishes public SEC EDGAR regulatory disclosure accessibility from dataset-wide commercial reuse permissions.
data_sources: US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) EDGAR public corporate disclosures
